menu_id.label: Menu
menu_id.description: Select a menu that should be used in the module. Click here to create new menu.

submenu_direction.label: Dropdown Menu Direction
submenu_direction.description: Here you can choose the direction that your sub-menus will open. You can choose to have them open downwards or upwards.

fullwidth_menu.label: Make Menu Links Fullwidth
fullwidth_menu.description: Menu width is limited by your website content width. Enabling this option will extend the menu the full width of the browser window.

active_link_color.label: Active Link Color
active_link_color.description: An active link is the page currently being visited. You can pick a color to be applied to active links to differentiate them from other links.

dropdown_menu_bg_color.label: Dropdown Menu Background Color
dropdown_menu_bg_color.description: Pick a color to be applied to the background of dropdown menus. Dropdown menus appear when hovering over links with sub items.

dropdown_menu_line_color.label: Dropdown Menu Line Color
dropdown_menu_line_color.description: Pick a color to be used for the dividing line between links in dropdown menus. Dropdown menus appear when hovering over links with sub items.

dropdown_menu_text_color.label: Dropdown Menu Text Color
dropdown_menu_text_color.description: Pick a color to be used for links in dropdown menus. Dropdown menus appear when hovering over links with sub items.

dropdown_menu_active_link_color.label: Dropdown Menu Active Link Color
dropdown_menu_active_link_color.description: Pick a color to be used for active links in dropdown menus. Dropdown menus appear when hovering over links with sub items.

mobile_menu_bg_color.label: Mobile Menu Background Color
mobile_menu_bg_color.description: Pick a unique color to be used for the menu background color when viewed on a mobile device.

mobile_menu_text_color.label: Mobile Menu Text Color
mobile_menu_text_color.description: Pick a color to be used for links in mobile menus.

logo.label: Logo
logo.description: Upload an image to display beside your menu.

logo_url.label: Logo Link URL
logo_url.description: If you would like to make your logo a link, input your destination URL here.

logo_url_new_window.label: Logo Link Target
logo_url_new_window.description: Here you can choose whether or not your link opens in a new window

logo_alt.label: Logo Alt Text
logo_alt.description: Define the HTML ALT text for your logo here.

logo_width.label: Logo Width
logo_width.description: Adjust the width of the logo.

logo_max_width.label: Logo Max Width
logo_max_width.description: Adjust the maximum width of the logo.

logo_height.label: Logo Height
logo_height.description: Adjust the height of the logo.

logo_max_height.label: Logo Max Height
logo_max_height.description: Adjust the maximum height of the logo.

cart_icon_color.label: Shopping Cart Icon Color
cart_icon_color.description: Here you can define a custom color for your shopping cart icon.

search_icon_color.label: Search Icon Color
search_icon_color.description: Here you can define a custom color for your search icon.

menu_icon_color.label: Hamburger Menu Icon Color
menu_icon_color.description: Here you can define a custom color for your hamburger menu icon.

cart_icon_font_size.label: Shopping Cart Icon Font Size
cart_icon_font_size.description: Control the size of the icon by increasing or decreasing the font size.

search_icon_font_size.label: Search Icon Font Size
search_icon_font_size.description: Control the size of the icon by increasing or decreasing the font size.

menu_icon_font_size.label: Hamburger Menu Icon Font Size
menu_icon_font_size.description: Control the size of the icon by increasing or decreasing the font size.

disabled_on.label: Disable on
disabled_on.description: This will disable the module on selected devices

admin_label.label: Admin Label
admin_label.description: This will change the label of the module in the builder for easy identification.

module_id.label: CSS ID
module_id.description: Assign a unique CSS ID to the element which can be used to assign custom CSS styles from within your child theme or from within Divi's custom CSS inputs.

module_class.label: CSS Class
module_class.description: Assign any number of CSS Classes to the element, separated by spaces, which can be used to assign custom CSS styles from within your child theme or from within Divi's custom CSS inputs.

menu_font.label: Menu Font
menu_font.description: Choose a custom font to use for the Menu. All Google web fonts are available, or you can upload your own custom font files.

menu_text_color.label: Menu Text Color
menu_text_color.description: Pick a color to be used for the Menu text.

menu_font_size.label: Menu Text Size
menu_font_size.description: Increase or decrease the size of the Menu text.

menu_letter_spacing.label: Menu Letter Spacing
menu_letter_spacing.description: Letter spacing adjusts the distance between each letter in the Menu.

menu_line_height.label: Menu Line Height
menu_line_height.description: Line height adjusts the distance between each line of the Menu text. This becomes noticeable if the Menu is long and wraps onto multiple lines.

cart_quantity_font.label: Cart Quantity Font
cart_quantity_font.description: Choose a custom font to use for the Cart Quantity. All Google web fonts are available, or you can upload your own custom font files.

cart_quantity_text_color.label: Cart Quantity Text Color
cart_quantity_text_color.description: Pick a color to be used for the Cart Quantity text.

cart_quantity_font_size.label: Cart Quantity Text Size
cart_quantity_font_size.description: Increase or decrease the size of the Cart Quantity text.

cart_quantity_letter_spacing.label: Cart Quantity Letter Spacing
cart_quantity_letter_spacing.description: Letter spacing adjusts the distance between each letter in the Cart Quantity.

cart_quantity_line_height.label: Cart Quantity Line Height
cart_quantity_line_height.description: Line height adjusts the distance between each line of the Cart Quantity text. This becomes noticeable if the Cart Quantity is long and wraps onto multiple lines.

background_color_gradient_repeat.label: Repeat Gradient
background_color_gradient_repeat.description: If enabled, defined gradient stops will be repeated until the outer boundary of the background is reached.

background_color_gradient_type.label: Gradient Type
background_color_gradient_type.description: Linear gradients radiate in a single direction across one axis. Radial gradients radiate from the center of the background in the shape of a circle.

background_color_gradient_direction.label: Gradient Direction
background_color_gradient_direction.description: Change the direction of the gradient by choosing a starting position within a 360 degree range.

background_color_gradient_direction_radi.label: Gradient Position
background_color_gradient_direction_radi.description: Change the direction of the gradient by choosing a starting position within a 360 degree range.

background_color_gradient_stops.label: Gradient Stops
background_color_gradient_stops.description: Add two or more color stops to your gradient background. Each stop can be dragged to any position on the gradient bar. From each color stop to the next the color is interpolated into a smooth gradient.

background_color_gradient_unit.label: Gradient Unit
background_color_gradient_unit.description: Define the units of your gradient stop positions.

background_color_gradient_overlays_image.label: Place Gradient Above Background Image
background_color_gradient_overlays_image.description: If enabled, gradient will be positioned on top of background-image

background_color_gradient_start_position.label: Start Position
background_color_gradient_start_position.description: By adjusting the starting position of the gradient, you can control how quickly or slowly each color transitions, and where the transition begins.

background_color_gradient_end_position.label: End Position
background_color_gradient_end_position.description: By adjusting the ending position of the gradient, you can control how quickly or slowly each color transitions, and where the transition begins.

parallax.label: Use Parallax Effect
parallax.description: If enabled, your background image will stay fixed as your scroll, creating a fun parallax-like effect.

parallax_method.label: Parallax Method
parallax_method.description: Define the method, used for the parallax effect.

background_size.label: Background Image Size
background_size.description: Choosing "Cover" will force the image to fill the entire background area, clipping the image when necessary. Choosing "Fit" will ensure that the entire image is always visible, but can result in blank spaces around the image. When set to "Actual Size," the image will not be resized at all.

background_position.label: Background Image Position
background_position.description: Choose where you would like the background image to be positioned within this element. You may want to position the background based on the the image's focus point.

background_repeat.label: Background Image Repeat
background_repeat.description: If the background image is smaller than the size of the element, you may want the image to repeat. This result will result in a background image pattern.

background_blend.label: Background Image Blend
background_blend.description: Background images can be blended with the background color, merging the two and creating unique effects.

background_video_mp4.label: Background Video MP4
background_video_mp4.description: All videos should be uploaded in both .MP4 .WEBM formats to ensure maximum compatibility in all browsers. Upload the .MP4 version here.
background_video_mp4.choose_text: Choose a Background Video MP4 File

background_video_webm.label: Background Video Webm
background_video_webm.description: All videos should be uploaded in both .MP4 .WEBM formats to ensure maximum compatibility in all browsers. Upload the .WEBM version here.
background_video_webm.choose_text: Choose a Background Video WEBM File

background_video_width.label: Background Video Width
background_video_width.description: In order for videos to be sized correctly, you must input the exact width (in pixels) of your video here.

background_video_height.label: Background Video Height
background_video_height.description: In order for videos to be sized correctly, you must input the exact height (in pixels) of your video here.

allow_player_pause.label: Pause Video When Another Video Plays
allow_player_pause.description: Allow video to be paused by other players when they begin playing

background_video_pause_outside_viewport.label: Pause Video While Not In View
background_video_pause_outside_viewport.description: Allow video to be paused while it is not in the visible area.

transform_styles.label: Transform
transform_styles.description: Using the transform controls, you can performance visual adjustments to any element using a combination of Scale, Translation, Rotation and Skew settings. This allows you to create advanced design effects without the need of a separate graphic design program.

positioning.label: Position
positioning.description: Here you can choose the element's position type. Absolutlely positioned elements will float inside their parent elements. Fixed positioned elements will float within the browser viewport. Relatively positioned elements sit statically in their parent container, but can still be offset without disrupting surrounding elements.

position_origin_a.label: Location
position_origin_a.description: Here you can adjust the element's starting location within its parent container. You can further adjust the element's position using the offset controls.

position_origin_f.label: Location
position_origin_f.description: Here you can adjust the element's starting location within its parent container. You can further adjust the element's position using the offset controls.

position_origin_r.label: Offset Origin
position_origin_r.description: Here you can choose from which corner this element is offset from. The vertical and horizontal offset adjustments will be affected based on the element's offset origin.

vertical_offset.label: Vertical Offset
vertical_offset.description: Here you can adjust the element's position upwards or downwards from its starting location, which may differ based on its offset origin.

horizontal_offset.label: Horizontal Offset
horizontal_offset.description: Here you can adjust the element's position left or right from its starting location, which may differ based on its offset origin.

z_index.label: Z Index
z_index.description: Here you can control element position on the z axis. Elements with higher z-index values will sit atop elements with lower z-index values.

text_orientation.label: Text Alignment
text_orientation.description: This controls how your text is aligned within the module.

background_layout.label: Text Color
background_layout.description: Here you can choose whether your text should be light or dark. If you are working with a dark background, then your text should be light. If your background is light, then your text should be set to dark.

width.label: Width
width.description: By default, elements will extend the full width of their parent element. If you would like to set a custom static width, you can do so using this option.

max_width.label: Max Width
max_width.description: Setting a maximum width will prevent your element from ever surpassing the defined width value. Maximum width can be used in combination with the standard width setting. Maximum width supersedes the normal width value.

module_alignment.label: Module Alignment
module_alignment.description: Align the module to the left, right or center.

min_height.label: Min Height
min_height.description: When a minimum height is set, the element will always have a height of at least the amount defined. This supersedes smaller static height values. Unlike height, minimum height does not result in content overflow and will allow the height of your element to remain dynamic.

height.label: Height
height.description: This sets a static height value for your element. Once set, the height of the element will no longer be determined by its inner content. Content that exceeds the static height of the element will overflow the element wrapper.

max_height.label: Max Height
max_height.description: Setting a maximum height will prevent your element from ever surpassing the defined height value. As your module content increases and surpasses the maximum height, it will overflow the element wrapper.

overflow-x.label: Horizontal Overflow
overflow-x.description: Here you can control element overflow on the X axis. If set to scroll, content that overflows static widths or heights will trigger a browser scrollbar. If set to hidden, content overflow will be clipped.

overflow-y.label: Vertical Overflow
overflow-y.description: Here you can control element overflow on the Y axis. If set to scroll, content that overflows static widths or heights will trigger a browser scrollbar. If set to hidden, content overflow will be clipped.

display_conditions.label: Display Conditions
display_conditions.description: Choose when to display this element based on a set of conditions. Multiple conditions can be added. Date & Time condition is based on your timezone settings in your WordPress General Settings

custom_margin.label: Margin
custom_margin.description: Margin adds extra space to the outside of the element, increasing the distance between the element and other items on the page.

custom_padding.label: Padding
custom_padding.description: Padding adds extra space to the inside of the element, increasing the distance between the edge of the element and its inner contents.

filter_hue_rotate.label: Hue
filter_hue_rotate.description: Shift all colors by this amount.

filter_saturate.label: Saturation
filter_saturate.description: Define how intense the color saturation should be.

filter_brightness.label: Brightness
filter_brightness.description: Define how bright the colors should be.

filter_contrast.label: Contrast
filter_contrast.description: Define how distinct bright and dark areas should be.

filter_invert.label: Invert
filter_invert.description: Invert the hue, saturation, and brightness by this amount.

filter_sepia.label: Sepia
filter_sepia.description: Travel back in time by this amount.

filter_opacity.label: Opacity
filter_opacity.description: Define how transparent or opaque this should be.

mix_blend_mode.label: Blend Mode
mix_blend_mode.description: Modify how this element blends with any layers beneath it. To reset, choose the "Normal" option.

child_filter_hue_rotate.label: Image Hue
child_filter_hue_rotate.description: Shift all colors by this amount.

child_filter_saturate.label: Image Saturation
child_filter_saturate.description: Define how intense the color saturation should be.

child_filter_brightness.label: Image Brightness
child_filter_brightness.description: Define how bright the colors should be.

child_filter_contrast.label: Image Contrast
child_filter_contrast.description: Define how distinct bright and dark areas should be.

child_filter_invert.label: Image Invert
child_filter_invert.description: Invert the hue, saturation, and brightness by this amount.

child_filter_sepia.label: Image Sepia
child_filter_sepia.description: Travel back in time by this amount.

child_filter_opacity.label: Image Opacity
child_filter_opacity.description: Define how transparent or opaque this should be.

child_mix_blend_mode.label: Image Blend Mode
child_mix_blend_mode.description: Modify how this element blends with any layers beneath it. To reset, choose the "Normal" option.

animation_style.label: Animation Style
animation_style.description: Pick an animation style to enable animations for this element. Once enabled, you will be able to customize your animation style further. To disable animations, choose the None option.

animation_direction.label: Animation Direction
animation_direction.description: Pick from up to five different animation directions, each of which will adjust the starting and ending position of your animated element.

animation_duration.label: Animation Duration
animation_duration.description: Speed up or slow down your animation by adjusting the animation duration. Units are in milliseconds and the default animation duration is one second.

animation_delay.label: Animation Delay
animation_delay.description: If you would like to add a delay before your animation runs you can designate that delay here in milliseconds. This can be useful when using multiple animated modules together.

animation_intensity_slide.label: Animation Intensity
animation_intensity_slide.description: Intensity effects how subtle or aggressive your animation will be. Lowering the intensity will create a smoother and more subtle animation while increasing the intensity will create a snappier more aggressive animation.

animation_intensity_zoom.label: Animation Intensity
animation_intensity_zoom.description: Intensity effects how subtle or aggressive your animation will be. Lowering the intensity will create a smoother and more subtle animation while increasing the intensity will create a snappier more aggressive animation.

animation_intensity_flip.label: Animation Intensity
animation_intensity_flip.description: Intensity effects how subtle or aggressive your animation will be. Lowering the intensity will create a smoother and more subtle animation while increasing the intensity will create a snappier more aggressive animation.

animation_intensity_fold.label: Animation Intensity
animation_intensity_fold.description: Intensity effects how subtle or aggressive your animation will be. Lowering the intensity will create a smoother and more subtle animation while increasing the intensity will create a snappier more aggressive animation.

animation_intensity_roll.label: Animation Intensity
animation_intensity_roll.description: Intensity effects how subtle or aggressive your animation will be. Lowering the intensity will create a smoother and more subtle animation while increasing the intensity will create a snappier more aggressive animation.

animation_starting_opacity.label: Animation Starting Opacity
animation_starting_opacity.description: By increasing the starting opacity, you can reduce or remove the fade effect that is applied to all animation styles.

animation_speed_curve.label: Animation Speed Curve
animation_speed_curve.description: Here you can adjust the easing method of your animation. Easing your animation in and out will create a smoother effect when compared to a linear speed curve.

animation_repeat.label: Animation Repeat
animation_repeat.description: By default, animations will only play once. If you would like to loop your animation continuously you can choose the Loop option here.

dropdown_menu_animation.label: Dropdown Menu Animation
dropdown_menu_animation.description: Select an animation to be used when dropdown menus appear. Dropdown menus appear when hovering over links with sub items.

hover_transition_duration.label: Transition Duration
hover_transition_duration.description: This controls the transition duration of the hover animation.

hover_transition_delay.label: Transition Delay
hover_transition_delay.description: This controls the transition delay of the hover animation.

hover_transition_speed_curve.label: Transition Speed Curve
hover_transition_speed_curve.description: This controls the transition speed curve of the hover animation.

link_option_url.label: Module Link URL
link_option_url.description: When clicked the module will link to this URL.

link_option_url_new_window.label: Module Link Target
link_option_url_new_window.description: Here you can choose whether or not your link opens in a new window

sticky_position.label: Sticky Position
sticky_position.description: Choose to have this element remain a fixed distance from the top or bottom edge of the browser window as the user scrolls

sticky_offset_top.label: Sticky Top Offset
sticky_offset_top.description: Define the vertical offset distance from the top edge of the browser window

sticky_offset_bottom.label: Sticky Bottom Offset
sticky_offset_bottom.description: Define the vertical offset distance from the bottom edge of the browser window

sticky_limit_top.label: Top Sticky Limit
sticky_limit_top.description: If defined, this element will stick to the top of this container, overriding its stickiness edge of the browser

sticky_limit_bottom.label: Bottom Sticky Limit
sticky_limit_bottom.description: If defined, this element will stick to the bottom of this container, overriding its stickiness to the edge of the browser

sticky_offset_surrounding.label: Offset From Surrounding Sticky Elements
sticky_offset_surrounding.description: Apply “Sticky Offset” to the nearest Sticky Element above or below this element

sticky_transition.label: Transition Default and Sticky Styles
sticky_transition.description: Enabled animated transitions between default and sticky styles when the element becomes “stuck”

scroll_effects.label: Scroll Transform Effects
scroll_effects.description: Using Scrolling Effects, you can transform elements on your page as you scroll. The animation's transition is based on the user's scrolling behavior. Once the element enters the browser viewport (top), the animation begins, and it once it leaves the viewport (bottom), the animation ends.

scroll_vertical_motion_enable.label: Enable Vertical Motion
scroll_vertical_motion_enable.description: Give this element vertical motion so that is moves faster or slower than the elements around it as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_vertical_motion.label: Set Vertical Motion
scroll_vertical_motion.description: Give this element vertical motion so that is moves faster or slower than the elements around it as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_horizontal_motion_enable.label: Enable Horizontal Motion
scroll_horizontal_motion_enable.description: Give this element horizontal motion so that it slides left or right as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_horizontal_motion.label: Set Horizontal Motion
scroll_horizontal_motion.description: Give this element horizontal motion so that it slides left or right as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_fade_enable.label: Enable Fading In and Out
scroll_fade_enable.description: Give this element an opacity effect so that it fades in and out as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_fade.label: Set Fading In and Out
scroll_fade.description: Give this element an opacity effect so that it fades in and out as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_scaling_enable.label: Enable Scaling Up and Down
scroll_scaling_enable.description: Give this element a scale effect so that it grows and shrinks as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_scaling.label: Set Scaling Up and Down
scroll_scaling.description: Give this element a scale effect so that it grows and shrinks as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_rotating_enable.label: Enable Rotating
scroll_rotating_enable.description: Give this element rotating motion so that it spins as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_rotating.label: Set Rotating
scroll_rotating.description: Give this element rotating motion so that it spins as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_blur_enable.label: Enable Blur
scroll_blur_enable.description: Give this element a blur effect so that it moves in and out of focus as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_blur.label: Set Blur
scroll_blur.description: Give this element a blur effect so that it moves in and out of focus as the viewer scrolls through the page.

motion_trigger_start.label: Motion Effect Trigger
motion_trigger_start.description: Here you can choose when motion effects are triggered: When the top of the element enters into view, when the middle of the element enters into view, or when the bottom of the element enters into view.
